rd_credit.applies_to: Accounting periods with a return date on or after 23 September 2027 (in general, years ending 31 December 2026 or later). Earlier: 30% and EUR 75,000.
rd_credit.source: Revenue Tax and Duty Manual Part 29-02-03 (updated April 2026), sections 1 and 2.3.1: https://www.revenue.ie/en/tax-professionals/tdm/income-tax-capital-gains-tax-corporation-tax/part-29/29-02-03.pdf

preliminary_tax.balance_due: With the return, on the 23rd day of the ninth month after the year-end

pillar_two.source: OECD GloBE Model Rules Article 9.2 (transitional substance-based income exclusion); Ireland's domestic top-up tax under Finance (No. 2) Act 2023
